# HirePrep - AI-Powered Resume Screening System

## Project Overview
MERN stack application with NLP-based resume screening capabilities. Features candidate and company portals with JWT authentication, AWS S3 file storage, and Python Flask microservice for intelligent resume analysis.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React.js with modern hooks and routing
- Backend: Node.js with Express.js REST APIs
- Database: MongoDB for user data and job postings
- Authentication: JWT tokens
- File Storage: AWS S3 for resume uploads
- NLP Service: Python Flask with spaCy/PyResparser
- Text Processing: NLTK for preprocessing

## Architecture
- Frontend React app for candidate and company dashboards
- Express.js API server with authentication middleware
- MongoDB for structured data storage
- Python Flask microservice for resume parsing and scoring
- AWS S3 integration for file management

## Key Features
- Dual role system (candidates and companies)
- Resume upload and parsing with NLP
- Job posting and candidate matching
- Skill extraction and scoring algorithms
- Real-time dashboard updates
